{{Doc/Template
|descr= Describes a game (and/or CDLC)
|param1= title
|descr1= game/CDLC title
|param2= image

|param4= storePage
|descr4= (Optional) store page (''usually'' Steam)
|param5= developer
|descr5= (Optional) studio's name
|param6= website
|descr6= (Optional) website link
|param7= wiki
|descr7= (Optional) Wiki link
|param8= forums
|descr8= (Optional) Forums link
|param9= discord
|descr9= (Optional) Discord link
|param10= facebook
|descr10= (Optional) Facebook link
|param11= twitter
|descr11= (Optional) Twitter link
|example1= <nowiki>{{Infobox/Game}}</nowiki>
